2610.12363.title: HANS: A Handwritten Answer Sheet Dataset for Noisy Hybrid Document Parsing
2610.12363.paper_summary: Intelligent grading and automated scoring technologies constitute critical infrastructure for smart education. However, existing document parsing and handwriting recognition benchmarks are predominantly designed for well-structured printed documents or isolated mathematical expressions, lacking datasets that capture the complex characteristics inherent to student answer sheets, including multi-line derivation processes, heterogeneous mixtures of text and mathematical formulae, and noise artifacts such as strikethroughs. To address this gap, we introduce HANS, the first dataset explicitly constructed for real-world educational scenarios, encompassing mathematical expressions, natural language text, hand-drawn tables, and diverse noise patterns including corrections and deletions, accompanied by fine-grained annotations that establish a reliable foundation for robust recognition research. Building upon HANS, we propose NA-GOT, an end-to-end framework that achieves two-stage noise suppression through a lightweight noise suppression module operating at the feature level, complemented by a noiseaware attention mechanism incorporated into the decoding stage. Experimental results demonstrate that HANS poses substantial challenges to existing methods, while NA-GOT achieves significant improvements in both accuracy and stability for answer process recognition. The dataset will be made publicly available upon publication.
2610.12363.paper_summary_zh: 智能評分和自動打分技術構成了智慧教育的關鍵基礎設施。<lb/>然而，現有的文檔解析和手寫識別基準主要是為了結構良好的印刷文檔或孤立的數學表達式而設計，缺乏能夠捕捉學生答卷固有的複雜特徵的數據集，包括多行推導過程、文本和數學公式的異質混合，以及如刪除線等噪聲伪影。<lb/>為了填補這一空白，我們介紹了HANS，這是第一個專門為現實教育場景構建的數據集，涵蓋了數學表達式、自然語言文本、手繪表格以及包括修正和刪除在內的多樣噪聲模式，並附有細緻的註釋，為穩健的識別研究建立了可靠的基礎。<lb/>在HANS的基礎上，我們提出了NA-GOT，一個端到端的框架，通過一個在特徵層面運作的輕量級噪聲抑制模塊實現兩階段的噪聲抑制，並輔以融入解碼階段的噪聲感知注意機制。<lb/>實驗結果表明，HANS對現有方法提出了重大挑戰，而NA-GOT在答題過程識別的準確性和穩定性方面取得了顯著改善。<lb/>該數據集將在發表時公開提供。
